run_findings.true_external_revision_gate_bounded_nega: Across the prior Authzed/SpiceDB evidence plus this run's current Permify, OpenFGA, OPA/Envoy and Cerbos official surfaces, no sampled external effect API satisfied all four conditions: expose authorization-state revision R, accept R on the effect request, atomically validate R at commit, and reject stale/revoked R. This is a bounded negative result only.
run_findings.permify_causal_freshness: Current Permify master e00d0522e2e5d9ccadac42625a3d40a9ba905360 documents Snap Tokens returned by authorization data writes and stored with application resources so later permission checks use a snapshot at least as fresh as the resource token. This is CAUSAL_AUTH_FRESHNESS_ONLY, not a lease for a later external mutation.
run_findings.openfga_mcp_request_gate: Current OpenFGA docs updated 2026-08-24 recommend checking every MCP tool request. authorization_model_id pins immutable policy/model version and HIGHER_CONSISTENCY bypasses caches, but the documented Check result does not expose a relationship-tuple snapshot revision analogous to SpiceDB checked_at. Classify as request-bound gating plus POLICY_VERSION_ONLY.
run_findings.opa_trace_policy_split: OPA decision_id is documented traceability only; per-bundle revision is policy-bundle provenance. Envoy ext_authz gates each request before upstream and fails closed by default unless failure_mode_allow=true. Keep TRACE_PROVENANCE_ONLY/POLICY_VERSION_ONLY separate from REQUEST_GATE_NO_DURABLE_REVISION.
run_findings.cerbos_request_gate: Current Cerbos agent/tool integrations such as Tailscale Aperture and Synapse/Envoy intercept tool/upstream requests and enforce a PDP decision inline. Public docs expose policy bundle/deployment versioning and audit, not an external effect mutation precondition bound to a prior authorization revision.
run_findings.resource_cas_is_independent: A resource ETag/blob SHA/generation can prevent stale-resource writes but cannot repair authorization TOCTOU after a detached ALLOW. The classifier now has RESOURCE_CAS_ONLY as a separate verdict.
